title: NFS: Improvements to NFSv4 dissection and filename snooping
description:
Improves the NFS dissector by refining NFSv4 dissection accuracy and fixing filename snooping logic for versions 2, 3, and 4. Addresses several protocol detection bugs, improves the human-readability of timestamps and file IDs, and cleans up the code by replacing magic numbers with macros. These updates ensure more reliable analysis and a clearer display of NFS traffic within Wireshark.

For more details, see descriptions of individual commits.
